claims.assertion: Athena says nebulae gather gas and particles around gravitational balance nodes between Pleiades stars; their colors reflect composition, and some gases emit light.
claims.speaker: Swaruu X (Athena)

claims.assertion: She models precession as a system-wide gravity-energy interaction, with Sirius prominent but not sole; cycle lengths depend on collective time perception.
claims.speaker: Swaruu X (Athena)

claims.assertion: Athena places Giza and Atlantis before Tiamat’s destruction, followed by flooding and Moon placement to stabilize Earth; she calls the Van Allen belt a byproduct, not a prison.
claims.speaker: Swaruu X (Athena)
claims.qualifiers: Her alternative chronology; she explicitly rejects the prison-purpose claim.
